decision: Reuse the frozen V9-V11 sampling distribution; no V12 temperature tuning.
evidence: V11 support at temperature 0.9 achieved 81.25% primary gold-action support, 22.22% primary task-reward variance, an 8.22% forbidden-action sample rate, and all three per-primary safety-variance gates. V12 changes only the prospective support composition so it mirrors the optimizer composition.
